What this means for your business

A few search basics help Google read the page. Useful content gives customers a reason to choose it. Each page should answer one real question, show why the answer is credible, and lead to proof or action.

What to watch

  • Ten pages saying the same thing with a neighborhood swapped in.
  • A title that promises more than the page delivers.
  • Facts a search system cannot see without an interaction.
  • page facts, headings, and visible copy telling different stories.

Do this next

  1. Give each page one question and one primary intent.
  2. Put the short answer near the top.
  3. Add first-hand detail, proof, or a useful method.
  4. Fix crawl, main web address, metadata, link, and mobile issues.

insight.answer: Google needs to understand what the page is for and whether it helps a person. Clear text, accurate facts, original value, working pages, and honest structure beat a pile of repeated keywords.
